verdict.rationale: Superpowers explicitly implements subagent-driven-development: the host agent (Claude Code, Devin, etc.) dispatches implementation tasks to subagents, which are then reviewed by a dedicated code-reviewer agent, with batching, circuit-breakers, and architectural-review safeguards documented in detail across release notes and the plugin docs. This is corroborated by independent blog commentary and HN discussion describing the dispatch-and-review loop in practice. Missing for 10: independent hands-on benchmarking of delegation quality (one HN commenter reports more mistakes when using it) and no controlled study confirming reliability at scale.
